does_not_do: A hosted platform from the same company is separate; the library itself is free.
focus_reason: Broad format support fits the need, with tests and a benchmark in CI. 62 releases in the year; 192 open issues.
measured_against: Need: turn statements and filings (PDF and office files) into text and tables a program can read, locally.
tests_ci: test_unstructured/ directories; a CI workflow and a partition benchmark.
what_it_is: Open-source components that partition PDFs, HTML, Word documents and images into structured elements for language-model pipelines.
